# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [Unreleased]

## [0.1.0] - 2026-08-16

### Added
- Provider-neutral CI service interface (`CIService`)
- Generic CI tools: `ci_status`, `ci_runs`, `ci_run`, `ci_jobs`, `ci_failure`, `ci_log`, `ci_artifacts`, `ci_rerun`, `ci_cancel`
- GitHub Actions provider (`GitHubActionsProvider`)
- Failure parser registry with support for: TypeScript, Jest/Vitest, pytest, Maven/Gradle, Go test, Cargo, ESLint, Docker build, dependency install, generic build
- Bounded CI log extraction with source reference
- Secret redaction pipeline
- Automatic repository detection from git remote
- Approval-gated write operations (default `writeEnabled = false`)
- Cordis lifecycle integration (mount/unmount clean)
- Unit tests and mock integration tests
- English and Chinese documentation
